verdict.rationale: Hands-on probes confirm that 1Password serves llms.txt on both its developer docs site and its support site. The developer site also serves llms-full.txt and a markdown mirror of every docs page. On top of that, there is a public, keyless docs MCP server and a dedicated ai-readable-docs page, so every part of pointing an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs is covered by verified runtime evidence.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: 1password.dev serves llms.txt ('# 1Password Developer Documentation') plus llms-full.txt, and every docs page has a real .md mirror
LLM-friendly exports of English public support guides from 1Password Support.
1Password's public docs MCP server at https://www.1password.dev/mcp completed a FULL keyless initialize handshake
